description: PROVIDER: set a node's price in US dollars per hour for the whole node (what the renter pays; the provider gets it minus the platform fee), or null to go back to the platform default. Must be within the node's price.min and price.max (50% to 300% of the default; see get_my_node). A rental already running keeps its price. Not possible on a spot node. Confirm the new price with the user first.

price_per_hour.description: USD per hour, or null for the default price.

name: set_node_price
